entities.name: Baron Wladimir Giesl von Gieslingen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Wladimir Rudolf Karl Freiherr Giesl von Gieslingen was an Austro-Hungarian general and diplomat during World War I, most famous for delivering the ultimatum to the Serbian government during the July Crisis of 1914.
